title: My Bank ‘Insider’ to Get an Unsecured $25K Credit Card
actionable_recommendations: Set up a corporation in your home state or in Wyoming/Delaware for anonymity.
Obtain an EIN from a corporate formation service when setting up your corporation.
Contact the recommended banker, Doris, to open a business account.
Take advantage of the 0% APR 7-month unsecured business credit card from Bank of America upon opening an account.
claims_requiring_current_verification: The ability to obtain up to $25,000 unsecured credit.
The claim that Bank of America and Chase are offering 0% APR credit cards for new businesses.
FEES and timelines related to obtaining an EIN and corporate formation services.
intended_organization_or_user: Individuals looking to start a business and obtain unsecured credit cards.
major_ideas: A different approach to applying for credit cards can increase approval chances.
Creating an anonymous corporation can protect business ownership privacy.
Utilizing 0% APR credit cards strategically can help build wealth.
prerequisites: Establish a business or corporation before applying for credit.
proposed_workflow: 1. Set up a corporation in your home state or Wyoming/Delaware.
2. Obtain an EIN through a corporate formation service.
3. Contact the banker Doris to open a business checking account.
4. Fund the account within 30 days to avoid closure.
5. Apply for the unsecured credit card upon opening the account.
